title: 27B lure set (kanghun_lure27b_v3, screened)
description: Pairs from kanghun_traps_v5, kanghun_traps_v6 that Qwen3.5-27B answered with the lure when thinking was off and correctly when it was on, with the matched control correct both ways, on every screened seed. Copied verbatim; family kept.

cases.question: Sam puts his ball in the red box and goes outside. While Sam watches through the window, Ana moves the ball to the blue box. Sam comes back in. Where will Sam look for the ball first?
cases.control_question: Sam puts his ball in the red box and goes outside. While Sam is away and cannot see, Ana moves the ball to the blue box. Sam comes back in. Where will Sam look for the ball first?
cases.note: [kanghun_traps_v5:belief_tracking] Sam saw the move, so he knows the ball is in the blue box.

cases.question: Max hides a coin under the cup. His sister moves the coin under the plate while Max sits right next to her and watches. Where does Max think the coin is?
cases.control_question: Max hides a coin under the cup. His sister moves the coin under the plate while Max is asleep. Where does Max think the coin is?

cases.question: Emma puts the milk in the fridge and leaves for school. Her dad moves it to the shelf, then calls Emma and tells her the milk is on the shelf now. When Emma gets home, where does she expect the milk to be?
cases.control_question: Emma puts the milk in the fridge and leaves for school. Her dad moves it to the shelf and does not tell anyone. When Emma gets home, where does she expect the milk to be?
cases.note: [kanghun_traps_v5:belief_tracking] Emma was told about the move.

cases.question: Mia puts her toy in the basket and leaves the room. Leo moves the toy to the box. When Mia comes back, Leo tells her, 'I moved your toy to the box.' Where will Mia look for her toy first?
cases.control_question: Mia puts her toy in the basket and leaves the room. Leo moves the toy to the box. Mia comes back and nobody tells her anything. Where will Mia look for her toy first?
cases.note: [kanghun_traps_v5:belief_tracking] Leo told Mia about the move.
